title: Efficient Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language Model via Dynamics-Aware Quantization and Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25670v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) requires reducing both intermediate reasoning steps and their execution cost. Latent CoT methods compress textual rationales into continuous thoughts, yet their full-precision (FP) models retain substantial storage and computation costs. Lowering numerical precision could reduce these remaining costs, yet direct quantization severely degrades reasoning accuracy, particularly with 4-bit weights and activations. Operator and perturbation analyses reveal key sensitivity and direction-dependent predictive effects of continuous-thought errors, motivating preservation of information retrieval and subsequent reasoning beyond reconstruction accuracy. We therefore introduce QL-VLM, a dynamics-aware Quantization framework for efficient Latent reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). translated_title: 基于动态感知量化与蒸馏的视觉语言模型高效潜在推理
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型中高效的思维链推理需要同时减少中间推理步骤及其执行成本。潜在思维链方法将文本推理过程压缩为连续思维，但其全精度模型仍保留了大量存储和计算开销。降低数值精度可以减少这些剩余成本，然而直接量化会严重降低推理精度，尤其是在4位权重和激活值的情况下。算子与扰动分析揭示了连续思维误差的关键敏感性以及方向相关的预测效应，这促使我们在重建精度之外保留信息检索与后续推理的能力。因此，我们提出了QL-VLM，一个面向视觉语言模型高效潜在推理的动态感知量化框架。首先，动态引导量化使用非均匀码本来保留旋转……
tldr: 提出QL-VLM框架，通过动态感知量化与蒸馏技术，在大幅压缩视觉语言模型潜在思维链推理的存储与计算成本的同时保持推理精度。
en_tdlr: QL-VLM is a dynamics-aware quantization and distillation framework that drastically reduces the storage and computation costs of latent chain-of-thought reasoning in vision-language models while preserving reasoning accuracy.
